<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Current: left blue at (14, 14), right blue at (39, 44)
# Try to get right blue to row 14

# UPx5 to move right blue up
for i in range(5):
    result = action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    blues = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'S':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = (min([p[0] for p in b]), max([p[0] for p in b]))
            cols = (min([p[1] for p in b]), max([p[1] for p in b]))
            blues.append((rows, cols))
    blues.sort(key=lambda x: x[1][0])
    print(f"After UP {i+1}: left={blues[0]}, right={blues[1]}")

# SPACE at top positions
result = action(['SPACE'])
print(f"\nAfter SPACE: level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] > 50:
        print(f"Black: hash={n['hash']}, children={n['children']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
